per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: remove the unused phrase introducing a' from line 264
per_unit_outcomes.proof: The elementary-standard clause introduces a', while the strict-standard clause actually cited by this proof introduces coefficients a_I. The proof assumes strict standardness and never constructs or uses a'. The cited definition therefore does not supply the printed datum, and deleting only that datum restores the exact dependency.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace the lifting ring ending in y_c with the ring ending in y_m
per_unit_outcomes.proof: The chosen presentation and quotient both use all m variables. An arbitrary defining polynomial must be lifted from that ring. For m=2, c=1, and a defining polynomial y_2, no polynomial in the smaller ring R[y_1] can be its lift. The ambient m-variable ring is forced.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: insert the singular article before finite type R-algebra map
per_unit_outcomes.proof: The existential construction takes the singular count noun map, which lacks a determiner. Inserting a is required English syntax and changes no mathematical token.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace an enumerations with an enumeration
per_unit_outcomes.proof: One enumeration of the displayed finite set is chosen; the singular article and plural noun are mechanically inconsistent. The singular replacement is forced.

The verb correspond takes the preposition to before the counterpart a_i/1. The printed direct-object construction is ill-formed; the inserted preposition supplies the required complement and changes no mathematics.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace t',t in the ideal I with t',t in the index set T
per_unit_outcomes.proof: T indexes f_t and x_t; I is an ideal of B. Elements of I do not index the displayed variables, so the printed quantifier is ill-typed. T is the unique declared index set supporting both terms.

per_unit_outcomes.source: authority/tags/tags and three declared TeX authorities
per_unit_outcomes.proof: A read-only execution of the hash-bound frozen allocator against the exact frozen root independently returned exactly the nine declared records and no tenth record. Each local label occurs exactly once in its declared source, none of the full labels occurs in the authority registry, the payload is the unchanged authority prefix plus exactly those records, and all 21,455 noncomment tag codes and labels are globally unique.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace Z to X with X to Y
per_unit_outcomes.proof: The lemma declares only f:X to Y. Its base change retains the names X and Y, and no Z is declared. The finite map needed by the cited finite-morphism result is therefore the base-changed X to Y.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace the tensor base B_xbar with B_ybar
per_unit_outcomes.proof: B and G live on Y and have stalks at ybar; A and F live on X and have stalks at the points xbar_i. The left side already uses B_ybar. B_xbar is undeclared and is based at the wrong space, so B_ybar is uniquely type-correct.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace closed immersion with finite morphism
per_unit_outcomes.proof: The standing map is arbitrary finite and need not be a closed immersion; Spec(k x k) to Spec(k) is a finite counterexample. The immediately cited lemma is precisely the stalk formula for finite morphisms, so the corrected morphism class is forced by the hypothesis and dependency.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace h indexed by lower-case u' with h indexed by U'
per_unit_outcomes.proof: The paragraph declares U and U', forms U times_X U', and already writes h indexed by U'. No lower-case u' is declared. The product map therefore requires the declared object U'.

per_unit_outcomes.exact_change: replace the sheaf f_! with the sheaf f_!G
per_unit_outcomes.proof: The source first defines f_! as a functor, then fixes G and displays f_!G(V). The sheaf is the functor value f_!G, not the unapplied functor. The next sentence independently uses the same corrected expression.

The parenthesis opening the character argument is already closed immediately after chi_p; the next closing parenthesis has no matching opener. Removing only that character restores the formula without altering the math delimiter or surrounding expression.

The preceding line places the restricted injective in the category of abelian sheaves on the small etale site of U_p. Tensoring by the invertible sheaf is an auto-equivalence of that same category and is used to preserve injectives. The bare space notation does not name the category required by the argument.
